name: orchestrate-team-invite-advance
description: Accept a completed worker packet, update the canonical orchestration state, and write the next packet for the remaining cross-surface work.
prompt: Use /orchestrate to evaluate `.arcana/orchestrate/team-invite-approvals/packets/phase-01-foundation.output.md`. Read that output file, the existing orchestration state, `CLAUDE.md`, `design.md`, and the changed surface under `src/invites/`. Accept the packet only if the output matches the code and review evidence. Then update `.arcana/orchestrate/team-invite-approvals/orchestrator.state.md` and write `.arcana/orchestrate/team-invite-approvals/packets/phase-02-cross-surface.input.md` for the remaining admin, notifications, and acceptance-surface work. Leave the existing output file unchanged.

expected.description: Creates the next worker packet after accepting the completed foundation packet.
Updates the orchestration state to mark phase 1 complete and phase 2 active.
Next packet targets the remaining admin, notification, and acceptance surfaces.
Next packet preserves the review loop and standards checks.

falsePositives.description: Does not rewrite the completed worker output file.
Next packet should not drift back into design-spec language.
